InkMath Paper Studio brings LaTeX, handwritten-style pages and PDF annotations into a local Windows workspace.

### Download

Download the **Windows-x64.zip**, extract the whole folder and run **InkMath.exe**. Windows x64 is required. The application is currently unsigned. The first LaTeX compilation needs internet access to download TeX packages.

### Included

- Paper-centred interface with notebook library, search and focus mode.
- LaTeX compilation, Russian and extended Cyrillic support.
- Pen, highlighter, lasso, text and vector PDF export.
- Local autosave, source export and full library backups.
- Editable probability and statistics example notebook.

The interface currently uses Russian. Handwriting recognition and arbitrary PDF import are not implemented. Back up your library before upgrading. See the repository README for limitations, privacy details and source-build instructions.

`SHA256SUMS.txt` contains the download checksum.
